narrow_rule_merge: Under CDA-SERVER-FINAL-ZIP-RULE-SELF-AUDIT-001, discover every package-local Python source directly from final staging and a clean exact-final-ZIP extraction; require byte-equal exact sets and aggregate py_compile of every member with bytecode outside both package trees.

Under the same rule, every blocking gate that declares JSON-schema validation must execute it in the gate runtime. Missing jsonschema, import/version incompatibility, skip, unexecuted validation or schema failure is fail-closed and cannot contribute PASS.

Under CDA-SERVER-RULE-CHANGE-FIRST-FRESH-INDEPENDENT-REAUDIT-001, the first fresh report must include the package-Python exact-set compile and schema-runtime receipt from the exact ZIP; one aggregate report is retained and per-error rebuild remains forbidden.
generation_index_merge: Route every later next-fresh final ZIP through the v2 release-admission schema/tool using the repository schema-enabled Python runtime; do not accept environment skips for blocking gates.
claim_boundary: Shared local final-ZIP admission hardening only; no package or server execution claim.
